paragraphs.source_en: Baba Nobufusa alone sheltered in the shade of a tree, watching his men die hideously. Why did so many men have to die? The demon of war, eyes blazing savagely and teeth clenched, continued its advance. Defeat no longer needed saying aloud. The white banner of Hachiman Tarō Yoshiie, the ancestral treasure of the Takeda Genji, had become a rag fluttering absurdly in the wind.
